name: AWS Neuron docs — Trn1/Trn1n Inference Performance tables
notes: Vendor reference inference numbers for Trn1/Trn1n (Trainium1). NeuronPerf-driven. Encoder models (BERT/RoBERTa/etc) reported as inference/sec; encoder-decoder (flan-t5-xl, t5-3b) reported as tokens/sec counting BOTH input and output tokens, NeuronX Distributed TP=8 on trn1.32xlarge. Last update 2026-02-26, SDK versions 2.17-2.28. Numbers are aggregate throughput across the data-parallel run mode, not per-request decode.
